summary: A companion to Under Pressure: Half Butterfly Mastery that separates entry problems, upper-body attacks and leg-entry study.
description: Find the relevant half-butterfly section in Brian Glick’s course before choosing an attack family.
overview: The course devotes its first volume to positioning and entries, then splits attack material across two volumes. The fourth volume is an executive summary, useful as an index when returning to a specific topic.

fits: You want half-butterfly study that includes how to reach the position and how the course separates its attack families.
consider_alternative_if: If your starting point is fully seated butterfly rather than half butterfly, compare Marcelo Garcia’s Butterfly Guard guide.

includes: Inside position, head position and entries from several bottom positions.
Sweeping and upper-body attacks in volume 2; near- and far-leg entries plus troubleshooting in volume 3.
limits: Half butterfly is the organizing position; a separate executive summary repeats the main subjects rather than adding a fourth attack family.

start_here.title: Use the summary to locate the full discussion
start_here.task: Compare volume 1’s basic-mechanics lesson with volume 4’s inside-frame and underhook summaries. Select the full discussion matching your current mechanics question. For head position, use the separate volume 1 lesson, The Issue of Head Position, before browsing the two attack groups.
